Design, develop, and maintain automated test solutions and frameworks. Plan and execute system, integration, and release testing (manual & automated). Validate interactions between hardware, embedded software, communication interfaces, DLL libraries and PC applications. Analyze test results, identify defects, and ensure clear reporting and documentation. Define test setups, tools, and equipment, coordinating required resources. Integrate testing into CI/CD pipelines and support continuous testing. Collaborate closely with embedded software, electronics, systems and application software engineers and continuously improve testing practices. This job is exactly right for you if... If you are excited about the role and have a solid technical background in software testing, software development, electronics, automation and bring relevant experience, we encourage you to apply. We also offer you... A key role in shaping test automation and quality in a global organization. An international, collaborative, and cross-functional work environment. A dynamic workplace combining innovation with Swiss stability. Learning and development opportunities via the maxon academy. High ownership in an individual contributor role. A permanent contract, competitive compensation, and flexible working hours. Additional benefits such as Club Natació de Barcelona membership and Cobee program.

CANDIDATO O candidato a admitir será responsável por: Coordenar e acompanhar projetos comerciais de âmbito corporate, definindo estratégias, objetivos, métricas de sucesso e planos de ação; Atuar como interlocutor interno na implementação de iniciativas comerciais, garantindo o alinhamento entre as equipas internas e os parceiros externos; Desenvolver, apresentar e promover novos projetos e iniciativas, assegurando a sua adesão e implementação junto dos diferentes stakeholders; Apoiar e acompanhar a equipa comercial corporate, promovendo a otimização de processos, performances e dinâmicas de trabalho; Definir, monitorizar e analisar KPI’s, elaborando recomendações que contribuam para a fidelização e angariação de clientes; Identificar oportunidades de melhoria e desenvolvimento de negócio, assegurando a sua implementação e acompanhamento; Desenvolver e gerir novas parcerias e oportunidades de negócio no segmento corporate; Recolher, analisar e interpretar informação de mercado, transformando-a em insights que suportem a tomada de decisão; Garantir uma gestão analítica e orientada para resultados, através da monitorização contínua das iniciativas implementadas. PERFIL Formação Superior em Gestão, Marketing, Economia ou áreas similares; Experiência mínima de 3 anos em funções de desenvolvimento de negócio, gestão de projetos comerciais, consultoria comercial ou áreas similares; Experiência em Contratação Pública; (preferencial) Conhecimentos sólidos em gestão e monitorização da performance de equipas; Domínio de Excel Avançado; Bons conhecimentos de inglês; Carta de condução há mais de 2 anos; Oportunidade de integração empresa em franca expansão. Os candidatos considerados serão contactados no prazo máximo de 10 dias úteis. EGOR Talent Acquisition Success Through People

review_candidates.title: Sales And Marketing Specialist in OTA
review_candidates.description: WE’RE HIRING – OTA & DISTRIBUTION MANAGER 🌍 Nordur Travel Services is a growing Icelandic tour operator offering Northern Lights tours, Golden Circle, South Coast, Highlands, private tours and 4x4 experiences. We are looking for an experienced OTA & Distribution Manager who can take ownership of our online distribution and help us grow sales across international marketplaces. Your responsibilities will include: •⁠ ⁠Managing and optimizing our existing OTA listings •⁠ ⁠Opening and developing new distribution channels •⁠ ⁠Improving product titles, descriptions, photos, pricing and conversion •⁠ ⁠Managing availability, pricing and product mapping through Bókun •⁠ ⁠Monitoring bookings, revenue, commissions and performance by channel •⁠ ⁠Identifying opportunities to increase sales in Asian, European and North American markets •⁠ ⁠Working directly with OTA account managers and resolving distribution issues •⁠ ⁠Regularly testing and improving product performance Platforms we are particularly interested in: GetYourGuide, Viator, Trip.com / Ctrip, Klook, Fliggy, KKday and other relevant tours & activities marketplaces. We are looking for someone who: •⁠ ⁠Has real hands-on experience managing OTAs in tourism, preferably tours & activities •⁠ ⁠Understands how to increase OTA sales — not just maintain listings •⁠ ⁠Is comfortable working with Bókun or similar reservation/channel-management systems •⁠ ⁠Understands pricing, commissions, conversion rates and distribution strategy •⁠ ⁠Can work independently and take full ownership of this area Experience with the Asian travel market, particularly China, is a strong advantage. This can be a remote position, so candidates do not need to be based in Iceland. We already have established products and significant booking volume. We are not looking for someone to simply maintain what exists — we want someone who can find opportunities we are currently missing and grow our OTA sales. Interested? Send us a short introduction together with your CV and, most importantly, tell us which OTA platforms you have personally managed and what results you achieved.

review_candidates.title: SR. PLANNING ENGINEER
review_candidates.description: Primary Purpose Of The Job Perform comprehensive Project Planning, Scheduling, Progress monitoring, Progress Verification and reporting activities necessary to achieve the successful execution of the assigned Project(s) from initiation to close-out. Required Experience And Skills Minimum 15 years’ experience in planning of projects in Oil & Gas including large capital and/or portfolio projects with onshore brownfield and greenfield projects including gas processing plants, refineries, onshore pipelines, etc. Preferably minimum 5 years’ experience in National Oil Companies and/or International Oil Companies. Experience in EPC project lifecycle, encompassing engineering, procurement, construction & commissioning Experience in pre-commissioning and commissioning planning, including system-wise handover strategies Experience in developing and managing shutdown schedules covering the full cycle: pre-shutdown preparation, shutdown execution and post-shutdown activities. Experience includes project planning, scheduling & phasing, project control & monitoring, forecasting, trending, risk assessment, variations/claims analysis, progress verification. High level of computer literacy with MS Office and relevant Project Control software including Primavera. Skills in Primavera Risk Analysis and Power BI are preferable. Work experience in the GCC is desirable Well-developed analytical and reporting skills. Educational Qualifications B. Sc. or equivalent in an Engineering Discipline. Preferably Certified PMP or equivalent certifications/memberships.
